items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions seeing Eubie Blake perform in Cincinnati in 1924 ('I went to the theatre to hear them... Eubie Blake and Noble Sissle'), but does not describe a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction beyond being an audience member.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about some of the shows they were having during the late 20's such as "Shuffle Along". Did you catch any of those "Blackbird" shows of the 20's?

No. I was at school then. Yeah, because I remember when they came to Cincinnati. They came to Cincinnati in 1924 and I went to the theatre to hear them... Eubie Blake and Noble Sissle. After the show broke up then Eubie Blake and Noble Sissle came back to Cincinnati, just as a team. I went out to hear them
several times. They played away out in Cincinnati for the rich people. We'd stand outside and listen.
